caption_L1: This is a bar graph named Coal production from deep and surface mining in the United Kingdom (UK) from 1970 to 2019 (in 1,000 metric tons). A linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 20,000 can be seen along the x-axis, labeled Surface mining. Year is plotted as a categorical scale with 1970 on one end and 2019* at the other along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: In 1990 coal production in UK peaked at around 20000 metric tons. In 2019 coal production in UK was at its lowest level. 1970 to 1975, 2005 to 2012 was approximately the same level of coal production in UK.
